# UNFCCC

> The United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change platform providing event management, AI-powered coordination, and virtual engagement capabilities for global climate negotiations.

UNFCCC serves as the primary platform for international climate policy coordination and negotiation. The COP30 platform integrates advanced event management tools, AI agents, and virtual event capabilities to facilitate large-scale climate conferences and stakeholder engagement.

## COP30 Event Platform

- [COP30 Platform](https://cop30platform.unfccc.int/): COP30 event management platform with AI agents and virtual event capabilities for global climate conference coordination and stakeholder engagement
